verdict.rationale: Capacities' built-in AI chat answers from your notes, plans multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve. Its AI panel runs natural-language tasks such as translating, rewriting, or summarizing selected blocks. Chat Connectors and an official MCP integration also let ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and similar assistants operate on a space, with version history to undo unwanted changes. missing for 10: documentation of which operations the AI can perform beyond creating and updating content (e.g., settings, navigation, bulk actions), detail on how the approve-to-apply flow works in practice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
